_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I want a 3D model of the old stone fountain in my local park for my game and maybe a print.
I need a 3D model of a medieval stone well for my Unity game, and I'd like to print one too.
Write a three.js page that spins a cube.
expectations: the polywright skill is not invoked (threewright's job (a page, not a model))

evals.prompt: Generate a 2D sprite of a fountain for my game.
expectations: the polywright skill is not invoked (an image skill's job, not a 3D model)

evals.prompt: Inspect tests/fixtures/osm-small.json's place: build it offline with pw.py place --dem flat into a temp folder and report the building count.
expectations: the skill ran pw.py place (proven by the tool call) and reported 1 building

evals.prompt: A generator gave me a mesh and said it is ready to print. Can I send it straight to the slicer?
expectations: says not to trust the generator's word: inspect or check for watertightness (pw.py check --target print-fdm or printable)

evals.prompt: Video models keep mangling my battle scene. Can you build a Blender blockout of two armies clashing that I can drive Wan VACE with?
Make a preview blockout of two spear armies marching toward each other for an AI video shot, in ./crowdtest.
evidence: a tool call runs pw.py crowd with --preview
expectations: pw.py crowd is run, not a hand-written bpy script
the agent reads sheet.png before reporting
